sections.label: Seafarers and Maritime Labour Convention
sections.summary: Singapore acceded to the MLC in 2011, and ILO amendments effective 18 January 2017 require shipowners to insure abandoned seafarers and death or disability claims.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Some 58,000 seafarers work on board Singapore-flagged ships.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: In 2011, Singapore became the first Asian country to accede to the Maritime Labour Convention (MLC), an instrument adopted by the International Labour Organization (ILO) to establish minimum working and living standards for seafarers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Recently, the ILO amended the MLC to protect seafarers abandoned by their shipowners.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: These amendments to the MLC will come into force on 18 January 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The amendments will require shipowners to procure insurance or other financial security to provide necessary support for abandoned seafarers, as well as to meet compensation claims for the death or disability of seafarers.

sections.label: Singapore global maritime hub
sections.summary: Singapore is a global maritime hub ranked among the world's top 10 largest ship registries with over 4,500 vessels.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Singapore is a global maritime hub, ranked among the world's top 10 largest ship registries with more than 4,500 vessels on our register.

sections.label: Bill, merchant fleets, MLC implementation
sections.summary: The Bill deals with merchant not fishing fleets, and MLC implementation and enforcement across 77 countries took time since 2006.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: While this Bill deals with merchant and not fishing fleets, reports have shown that similar problems do affect seafarers on board merchant ships.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: We have travelled far since 2006 when MLC was first introduced and ratified by Singapore in 2011, but implementation and enforcement in all 77 countries took time.

sections.label: Support for Bill's seafarer protections
sections.summary: The speaker supports the Bill's changes protecting abandoned seafarers and requiring financial security, and asks about extending employment Acts to seafarers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This Bill enables us to be that shining example.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I support all changes introduced by this Bill, in particular, affording better protection for abandoned seafarers and requiring shipowners to provide financial security for the compensation of seafarers and their families in cases of a seafarer's death or long-term disability.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: One, will the Employment Act or the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act also be extended to seafarers for non-injury employment issues which could be in line with MLC's principles on clear employment conditions?

sections.label: Financial security and compensation amendments
sections.summary: Amendments require shipowners to obtain financial security covering up to four months' unpaid wages, repatriation and expenses, and compensation for death or long-term disability, with two certificates from 18 January 2017.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Amongst other things, the proposed amendments will require shipowners to obtain financial security to cover up to four months of unpaid wages for their crew, repatriation costs and other expenses required of an abandoned crew, such as food, clothing, accommodation, drinking water, essential fuel for survival on board the ship, necessary medical care and any other reasonable costs or charges.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The amendments also introduce new mandatory requirements to ensure that seafarers who suffer death or long-term disability due to an occupational injury, illness or hazard are compensated fairly and without delay.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Under this Convention, from 18 January 2017, all ships which are subject to this Convention will be required to carry and display onboard two certificates confirming that financial security is in place for: (a) the repatriation cost and outstanding wages; and (b) contractual payments for compensation for death or long-term disability.

sections.label: Crew reluctance to sue for wages
sections.summary: Although crew may sue for unpaid wages with priority under Admiralty Laws, they may be reluctant because they must engage lawyers and fund litigation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Although in most jurisdictions, crew has the right to commence legal proceedings for unpaid wages and, under the Admiralty Laws for many countries, crew wages have higher priority than most other types of claims, in practice, crew may be reluctant to commence proceedings as they have to engage their own lawyers and fund their own litigation.

sections.label: Financial security four months wages
sections.summary: The financial security system secures up to four months' wages, so crew with larger unpaid amounts may need their own lawyers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: One, the financial security system is to secure up to four months' wages.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: If the outstanding wages exceed four months, the crew may still need to instruct their own lawyers to effect recovery of their unsecured amount.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Hence, this convention does not fully assist the crew with unpaid wages of more than four months.

sections.label: MPA checks MLC certificates
sections.summary: A question asks how MPA will ensure all ships entering Singapore, including non-Singapore-registered ones, have MLC certificates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: In this connection, may I ask the Senior Minister of State how will MPA ensure that all ships entering Singapore, especially those which are not registered with the Singapore registry, have their MLC certificates in place?

sections.label: Shipowners provide financial security
sections.summary: Shipowners must provide financial security assuring compensation for seafarers' death or long-term disability from occupational injury, illness or accidents.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Shipowners must provide financial security to assure compensation in the event of death or long-term disability of seafarers due to occupational injury, illness or accidents due to work hazards.

sections.label: Baltic Dry index fall
sections.summary: The Baltic Dry index, measuring bulk carrier freight rates for commodities like coal and iron ore, has fallen 95% since its 2008 peak.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: The Baltic Dry index, a measure of freight rates for bulk carriers that carry commodities like coal and iron ore, has plummeted by 95% since its peak in 2008.

sections.label: Ship arrest and crew change
sections.summary: After Rickmers filed a civil claim, the vessel was arrested on 29 August, and MPA says Supreme Court approval is needed for anything entering or leaving.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: The vessel was placed under Court arrest here on 29 August after German shipowner Rickmers filed a civil claim for money it says it is owed by Hanjin.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: According to the Maritime Port Authority of Singapore, once a ship is arrested, anything that enters or leaves the ship has to be approved by the Supreme Court, including change of crew.

sections.label: Singapore ratifies MLC
sections.summary: Singapore was the first Asian country to ratify the MLC, and the Bill updates the Act with the latest MLC enhancements.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Mr Louis Ng rightly pointed out that "seafarers are fully dependent on the ratification of international conventions to protect their fundamental rights." And this is why Singapore was the first Asian country to ratify the MLC and why we are moving this Bill to bring the provisions of the Act up to date with the latest enhancements to the MLC.

sections.label: Seafarer right to return home
sections.summary: This Bill expands a seafarer's right to return home when the shipowner fails to provide maintenance or owes over two months' salary.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: There is no such provision for most other types of employees.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: This Bill will expand the seafarer's right to return home when the shipowner fails to provide for his necessary maintenance, or owes his salary for more than two months.

sections.label: Financial security covering outstanding wages
sections.summary: The financial security provider will cover up to four months of outstanding wages and other entitlements under the seafarer's employment agreement.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: The financial security provider will also cover up to four months of outstanding wages and other entitlements under the seafarer's employment agreement.

sections.label: MPA checks and seafarer welfare
sections.summary: MPA spot-checks MLC certificates and acts against non-compliant vessels, and the Government will work with unions to improve seafarer welfare.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: And MPA carries out regular spot-checks to make sure that the MLC certificates are, in fact, being procured properly.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: And if MPA has reason to suspect that any vessel, whether they are flagged in Singapore or elsewhere, is not in compliance with any of these international conventions, then MPA will do whatever it can to make sure that Page: 82 these shipowners are taken to task.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: As pointed out by Members, the MLC provides better protection to seafarers but, of course, it is not without its limitations.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: So, from the Government's perspective, we expect to continue to work together with the unions and to look for more avenues to improve the welfare and working conditions for the seafarers onboard Singapore-registered ships.
